# GitHub repository profile settings

GitHub's **About** section is repository metadata and is not populated automatically from README.md.

## Description — paste into About

```text
Unified Crypto Trading API Gateway — Official API & Web Session integrations for trading bots.
```

## Website

```text
https://t.me/trusty_kyc_manager
```

## Topics — enter each separately

```text
crypto
trading-api
api-gateway
trading-bots
algorithmic-trading
websocket
python
```

## Update on GitHub

1. Open https://github.com/panoljk/webapi-bridge
2. In the right-side **About** panel, select the gear / edit icon.
3. Paste the description and website URL.
4. Add the topics above, then save.

**Note:** The README currently features a working local read-only sandbox; production trading connectors are not released. Do not imply otherwise in the repository description or topics.
